title: The Brooklyn Bridge, Heights, Dumbo Tour
includes: Licensed Tour guide who will engage with guests and answer questions throughout the trip.
Ferry Ride. Guests can purchase Ferry tickets for $5 fro kiosk at the end (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Accessible to anyone who can handle 8,000 steps in the weather of that day.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is visually the most beautiful walking tour out of any offered in NYC. We will cover the entirety of the bridge with multiple stops for photos, then enter the quieter suburbs of Brooklyn Heights to see the Promenade. After that we head in to the crowded and exciting DUMBO!
